page.notes: The Hebrew words are printed with vowel points and are often broken by the scan. I have transcribed the Latin text carefully, but I could not read most Hebrew forms letter by letter, so they are marked as approximate placeholders instead of guessed. The Hebrew header marks at the top of the columns are not transcribed. Left-column line "mandabitur" and the first Hebrew words of several entries are partly obscured by scan damage and show-through. The Hebrew catchword at the foot is read as דיעלנו with some doubt. Numbers and abbreviations are copied as printed.
